notes.title: To The Moon Update for Asian Food Cart Tycoon Out Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43527279/9bc4b331c97e5ddcdf4a41f92907280bed99ca9a.jpg[/img]

It's here!

To The Moon Update:

1. Added the Lucky Spin system that players can play to get prizes

2. Thugs will come to your shop within a certain time to challenge you to play rock, paper, scissors. Win the challenge so that your money is not taken!

3. Added a clown mascot system that will help you attract more customers.

4. New maps! Now you can sell satay on the moon! Meet all kinds of customers from astronauts and aliens, even rockets!

5. Adding effects and stars to Indonesian YouTubers who come to the shop

notes.title: New Update Coming Soon!
notes.content:
A new update for Asian Food Cart Tycoon is heading your way soon. 

Featuring:

- A new world (sell Satay on the moon)
- Mini Games
- Overhaul and deepening of the game economy
- Spin feature
- And much much more...

notes.title: Asian Food Cart Tycoon is Released Today!
notes.content:
Asian Food Cart Tycoon has been released today! There are all kinds of things waiting for you and let's play now! Asian Food Cart Tycoon has interesting gameplay and various features that you can try. This game itself has a price of [b]$9.99[/b] and there will be a special price later for Indonesia.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43527279/dff7d0a0d4094d72fec914453f5cbe454b29ffe7.png[/img]

[b]Features:[/b]

[list]
[*] Manage and develop your satay business
[*] Upgrade your facilities
[*] Lots of characters
[*] Advertise your business
[*] Daily missions
[*] Meet the VIP!
[*] Collect some airdrops
[*] Day and night cycle
[/list]

Let's play now and help Ujang to sell satay and become the best satay businessman in the world!
